<STRUCT_0001>
This section is the analogue of
Modules on Sites, Section <REF_0001>
for the <ACCENT_0001>tale site.

Let <MATH_0001> be a scheme.
Let <MATH_0002> be a sheaf of sets on <MATH_0003>.
<STRUCT_0001>
<STRUCT_0002> Let <MATH_0004> be a set. We say <MATH_0005> is the
<TEXTITOPEN_0001>constant sheaf with value <MATH_0006><TEXTITCLOSE_0001> if <MATH_0007> is the
sheafification of the presheaf <MATH_0008>.
Notation: <MATH_0009> or <MATH_0010>.
<STRUCT_0003> We say <MATH_0011> is a <TEXTITOPEN_0002>constant sheaf<TEXTITCLOSE_0002> if it is
isomorphic to a sheaf as in (1).
<STRUCT_0004> We say <MATH_0012> is <TEXTITOPEN_0003>locally constant<TEXTITCLOSE_0003> if there exists a
covering <MATH_0013> such that <MATH_0014> is a constant sheaf.
<STRUCT_0005> We say that <MATH_0015> is <TEXTITOPEN_0004>finite locally constant<TEXTITCLOSE_0004> if it
is locally constant and the constant values are finite sets.
<STRUCT_0006>
Let <MATH_0016> be a sheaf of abelian groups on <MATH_0017>.
<STRUCT_0007>
<STRUCT_0008> Let <MATH_0018> be an abelian group.
We say <MATH_0019> is the <TEXTITOPEN_0005>constant sheaf with value <MATH_0020><TEXTITCLOSE_0005> if
<MATH_0021> is the sheafification of the presheaf <MATH_0022>.
Notation: <MATH_0023> or <MATH_0024>.
<STRUCT_0009> We say <MATH_0025> is a <TEXTITOPEN_0006>constant sheaf<TEXTITCLOSE_0006> if it is isomorphic
as an abelian sheaf to a sheaf as in (1).
<STRUCT_0010> We say <MATH_0026> is <TEXTITOPEN_0007>locally constant<TEXTITCLOSE_0007> if there exists a
covering <MATH_0027> such that <MATH_0028> is a constant sheaf.
<STRUCT_0011> We say that <MATH_0029> is <TEXTITOPEN_0008>finite locally constant<TEXTITCLOSE_0008> if it
is locally constant and the constant values are finite abelian groups.
<STRUCT_0012>
Let <MATH_0030> be a ring. Let <MATH_0031> be a sheaf of <MATH_0032>-modules
on <MATH_0033>.
<STRUCT_0013>
<STRUCT_0014> Let <MATH_0034> be a <MATH_0035>-module.
We say <MATH_0036> is the <TEXTITOPEN_0009>constant sheaf with value <MATH_0037><TEXTITCLOSE_0009> if
<MATH_0038> is the sheafification of the presheaf <MATH_0039>.
Notation: <MATH_0040> or <MATH_0041>.
<STRUCT_0015> We say <MATH_0042> is a <TEXTITOPEN_0010>constant sheaf<TEXTITCLOSE_0010> if it is isomorphic
as a sheaf of <MATH_0043>-modules to a sheaf as in (1).
<STRUCT_0016> We say <MATH_0044> is <TEXTITOPEN_0011>locally constant<TEXTITCLOSE_0011> if there exists a
covering <MATH_0045> such that <MATH_0046> is a constant sheaf.
<STRUCT_0017>
